purpose: Sprites conceituais dos quatro bosses; sem integração ao jogo.

sprites.name: Anúbis
sprites.subject: Anubis the Weigher of Souls. Tall slender jackal-headed Egyptian deity, long upright ears, charcoal jackal face, ivory and dark slate pleated ceremonial kilt, engraved broad collar and simple gold clasps. Holds a clearly readable gold balance scale to one side with feather and symbolic heart pans, other hand carries a long slender staff. Solemn ancient guardian.

Mature realistic elongated proportions, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, antique Renaissance woodcut crosshatching translated into pixel art. sprites.name: Hades
sprites.subject: Hades the Lord of the Underworld. Imposing stern mature bearded Greek king in a heavy charcoal robe over engraved dark silver ancient armor, angular antique gold crown. Holds a clearly readable tall BIDENT with exactly TWO prongs beside his body. Bone-pale face, tattered drapery, restrained spectral ivory wisps around lower robe. Ominous regal posture, no fire demon, no devil horns.

sprites.name: Odin
sprites.subject: Odin the All-Father. Ancient one-eyed Norse wanderer king, one dark eyepatch, long silver beard, engraved iron helmet with NO horns, ragged charcoal cloak over sparse rune-etched armor. Holds long Gungnir spear upright beside body, a small black raven perched on opposite shoulder. Bone-silver runes and tiny aged gold clasps. Severe wise silhouette.

sprites.name: Caos Primordial
sprites.subject: Primordial Chaos, the Void Before Creation. A single non-humanoid cosmic entity, asymmetrical swirling black void enclosed in broken bone-silver armillary arcs and an incomplete ouroboros ring, jagged engraved star fragments and elongated curling shadow tendrils form a tall floating silhouette. Central hollow eclipse with a narrow pale rim, scattered ancient geometric fragments. No human face, no dragon, no person, no throne, no background diagram, no bright colored nebula. Powerful abstract cosmic boss.
